notes:
# v1.3.10 — iOS-style reader settings sheet

- Reworked the reader settings sheet (App Store themes) into a native iOS
  settings sheet: a grabber handle, a large "Reading Settings" title with a
  Done button, and grouped inset cards under uppercase section headers
  (Reading Mode, Display, Performance, Chapters, Translation & OCR, Theme,
  Novel Display).
- Reading mode is now an iOS segmented control, and the Theme picker is an
  iOS-style segmented control instead of three ad-hoc buttons.
- Switches, sliders and the performance select follow the iOS control look;
  the sheet header is sticky and frosted so Done stays reachable while
  scrolling.
- Tapping the dimmed backdrop now dismisses the sheet (in addition to Done).
- Fix: the Novel Display section (and other sheet sub-groups) now actually
  hide for manga readers. The inline `display:flex` on those groups used to
  defeat the global `.hidden` rule; a sheet-scoped `.hidden` rule wins again.
- Scope: applies to the App Store themes only — Dark (Legacy) and Light
  (Legacy) keep their existing reader settings sheet unchanged.
